lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters; the central lateral row exhibits the largest diameter and spacing between centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows, creating a defined grid of high-luminance anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A singular longitudinal ridge running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on top to shadow below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, low-contrast high-luminance blobs concentrated in the basal and posterior sections of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct horizontal linear marking or scar is visible on the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin; possible irregular notch on the posterior margin of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (remoras) attached to the ventral region and the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
